body:
## Summary

`/admin` works for every platform admin. It is also simpler: its sections are Overview, Organizations, Users, Invites, Access and Support & audit, and an admin MCP server comes with it.

- **Fix the 404 (RP-21):** an allowlisted admin who opened `/admin` before clicking "Admin console" got the 404 cloak. Staging showed the same thing. Such an admin now sees a "Switch to admin mode" screen, which returns them to the page they typed. Anyone not eligible still gets the 404.
- **Rename and simplify (RP-22, RP-74):** Customers is now Organizations, and `/admin/customers` redirects there. Traces, Pricing, Access requests and Quality are removed. Support sessions and the audit log are one page, and `/admin/audit` redirects to it. The admin folders are now `owned` in `platform-sync/map.json`, because ratel-cloud is frozen.
- **Remove the request flow (RP-23, decision d5-invites-only):** a new private migration `0010` drops `feature_access_requests`, and the request constants and events are gone. The launch gate keeps grants, platform invitations, team invitations and domains. `db/cutover.ts` now accepts a table that a newer migration drops.
- **Admin MCP server (RP-24, port of ratel-cloud #475):** `POST /api/admin/mcp`.
  - OAuth only, platform admins only; the allowlist is checked again on every tool call.
  - Off unless `FF_ADMIN_MCP` is set.
  - Nine reads and three audited writes: `invite_person`, `invite_organization`, `grant_launch_access`.

Twin: ratel-ai/ratel#377 (same branch, `feat/simplify-admin`), which removes the core's Quality console. Merge this PR first.

The dropped table's row count on staging is still to be read before merge.

## Proof

All evidence is on the `proof/rp-21` branch ([README](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/README.md)). Commit pair: ratel-platform `21009916` and ratel `bc50fb77`.

- 404 test: it fails on the old behavior ([red](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/01-admin-404-test-red.log)) and passes with the fix ([green](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/01-admin-404-test-green.log)).
- Targeted tests:
  - Launch gate per D5: 28 pass.
  - Schema, migrate and cutover: 31 pass.
  - Admin MCP: 29 pass.
  - Route set and the customer-wording grep also pass.
- [Typecheck and boundary](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/03-typecheck-boundary.log): both clean.
- [MCP Inspector](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/04-admin-mcp-inspector.log): as an admin, it lists 12 tools and the organizations. As a non-admin, it gets 403 `forbidden`.
